sources: Event lists + tier charts printed in each 2026-27 PI PDF
DECA Guide 2026-27 (Principles, Series, TDM guideline pages)
DECA Direct: 13 Things Every Advisor Should Know for 2026-2027 (Aug 2026)
Official 2026-27 sample role-plays: PMK-26, PFL-26, BFS-26 District Event 1, ETDM-26, FMS-26 District Event 1

principles.composition: All 4 PIs from ONE instructional area.

individual_series.pools: Tier 1 + Tier 2 + the event's Tier 3 pathway
individual_series.composition: >=3 PIs from ONE primary instructional area; >=1 PI from the event's pathway pool. Supporting PIs usually come from ONE other IA, often a soft-skill IA (BFS-26: 3 Financial Analysis + 2 Communication Skills).

team_decision_making.composition: >=3 PIs from ONE primary instructional area (DECA's old 7-PI rule was >=4 of 7; 5-PI version is an inference).

personal_financial_literacy.composition: All 3 from ONE topic, usually from 1-2 related standards; grades 8 and 12 (PFL-26 used three grade-8 Managing Credit outcomes). Never grade 4.
